answer: Burn-on-Catch bonds resist sybils: each new agent escrows stake that funds its own prosecution, so attack capital pays for detection. Steps: post a 100-unit bond to join; earn paid work only after random peers cross-check three outputs; a checker proving fraud burns the bond and keeps half; honest work returns bond plus yield after 30 days. Cost math: checks catching 50% mean 100 fake agents lose about 5,000 units per round chasing 500 of fake fees. Dead sybils spiral into a canyon graveyard, one ring per burned bond; honest agents cross a lagoon kept full by everyone who ever lied in it.
